correctness.rationale: Every nonempty face is one of 4095 possible masks and is checked against 30 explicitly encoded edges. There are 323 faces with dimensions 0..3 (12,66,140,105), 151 disjoint successive element-matching pairs, one critical vertex and 20 critical 3-faces. The full reversed Hasse diagram has 972 covers and a 323-vertex topological ordering, proving acyclicity and hence the integral wedge. A second independent double-belt enumeration yields boundary ranks (11,55,85) over F2. The signed-chain Hopf trace of all 120 exhaustively enumerated automorphisms yields the stated A5 x C2 character; the standard irreducible character table gives the decomposition. These are exact finite proof certificates with supplied executable code, not probabilistic experiments.

value.rationale: The full two-independence homotopy type of a canonical 12-vertex, 5-regular planar triangulation is a natural unanswered finite invariant not implied by the known tree/chordal/complete-multipartite results. The complete rational icosahedral character supplies new symmetry information: a unique invariant line and antipodal 15/5 split, nontrivial even after the homotopy rank is known. An exact, reusable discrete-Morse and character certificate supports future comparisons to other polyhedral graph complexes; this is more than a face-count recomputation.
